name: Efficient Large Language Models
description: Research focusing on improving and optimizing the performance and functionality of large language models, including adaptation, compression, editing, and safety protocols.

name: Multimodal Vision and Language
description: Research on the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing, covering tasks such as multimodal reasoning, question answering, and content generation, as well as the evaluation and benchmarking of models for these tasks.

name: LLM Reasoning and Evaluation
description: This category encompasses research on the development, evaluation, and optimization of Large Language Models (LLMs) focusing on their reasoning capabilities and performance assessments.

name: Multilingual NLP Advancements
description: This category encompasses research focused on developing, fine-tuning, evaluating, and improving the performance of large-scale, multilingual language models in diverse cultural, linguistic, and context-specific scenarios.

name: Large Language Model Safety and Security
description: This category covers research on mitigating vulnerabilities, ensuring robustness, and developing defense mechanisms for Large Language Models against various types of attacks and security threats.

name: Large Language Model Analysis
description: This category focuses on the evaluation and analysis of the internal representations, compositional abilities, and applications of Large Language Models.

name: Multimodal Dialogue and Conversational AI
description: This category encompasses research in understanding, generating, and evaluating multimodal conversations, including dialogue systems, role-playing agents, sentiment analysis, and social intelligence in large language models.

name: Large Language Model Research
description: This category covers the development, evaluation, and applications of Large Language Models in various Natural Language Processing tasks and domains.

name: Large Language Model Safety and Ethics
description: This category encompasses research on large language model evaluation, alignment, and mitigation of safety concerns across various domains, including bias, fairness, hate speech, persuasion, and social interaction.

name: Large Language Model-based Reasoning and Retrieval
description: This category covers the application of large language models in various reasoning and retrieval tasks, including question answering, text generation, and information extraction.
